subject: PO enforcement thresholds and onboarding intake for TrialCo pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ella Park <ella@trialco.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: PO enforcement thresholds for TrialCo pilot 

Hi Hannah / Karthik / Ella,

Quick context: TrialCo is ready to start a 6-week pilot but their finance team says they won't be able to provide a formal PO in time for the kickoff. They are small, fast-moving, and want to avoid procurement delays.

Question for procurement: what flexibility do we have on our PO enforcement threshold for pilots? Current policy I have is PO required for commitments >= $5k, but if we can make a short-term exception or raise the threshold for early pilots it would unblock TrialCo.

Ella — is your team able to accept a single consolidated invoice at the end of the pilot (or prepay)? If not, what are the constraints and timelines from your side?

We want to balance compliance with speed. If there's a short-form evidence checklist or a restricted temporary path (invoice-only, single invoice, prepayment, or virtual card) we can propose it and get the internal approvals.

Next steps I propose:
- Hannah: confirm what evidence we need for a temporary invoice-only onboarding and whether there's an approval ladder for pilot exceptions
- Karthik: if legal/finance signoff is needed, can you own getting that in parallel with the trial SOW?
- Ella: share finance contact and preferred payment path

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
(attachment: TrialCo_SOW_draft.pdf (pdf))

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ella Park <ella@trialco.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO enforcement thresholds for TrialCo pilot

Marissa — thanks for the context.

Short answer: we have a policy guardrail that requires a PO for net committed spend >= $5,000 over a 30-day window. That said, procurement can approve a temporary "pilot exception" for up to 45 days provided the vendor completes a minimal intake and finance accepts an agreed single-invoice cadence.

What we would need from TrialCo to consider the exception:
- Completed vendor onboarding form (basic KYC + billing contact) — I can share a one-sheet instead of the full intake form for speed.
- Confirmation from TrialCo finance that they will accept consolidated invoice (single invoice) or will provide a prepayment/virtual card for the pilot amount.
- Point of contact and estimated pilot spend (approx $) and dates so we can time-limit the exception.

Proposed controls on our side if we approve an exception:
- Exception duration: 45 days from pilot start, non-renewing without formal PO
- Limit: $10,000 cap for the exception (we'll enforce at billing)
- Evidence: signed SOW or email confirmation of scope and dates; vendor onboarding one-sheet attached

Marissa — I can approve at the procurement level if the above checklist is met. Karthik, flag if legal needs to sign the one-sheet. If TrialCo agrees, I'll route the exception for a quick operational approval and provide an intake link (vendor form).

Attaching: Vendor_Onboard_Form.xlsx (one-sheet)

Hannah Schmitt
Head of Procurement | Redwood Inference

From: Ella Park <ella@trialco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Mar 2026 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO enforcement thresholds for TrialCo pilot

Thanks Marissa/Hannah — really appreciate the flexibility.

We can do a consolidated single invoice at pilot close. Our finance lead (procurement@trialco.com) confirms they can accept a single invoice for the pilot amount. They cannot issue a PO in the next two weeks due to internal change freezes.

Estimated pilot spend: ~$6,200 over 4 weeks (mostly usage-based). Pilot dates: Mar 15 — Apr 12.

Action items from our side:
- I'll complete your one-sheet onboarding form and return it today
- Send contact: procurement@trialco.com (cc'd here)
- We can sign the SOW draft you attached; hoping to get that back by end of day Monday

Question: if the exception cap is $10k and duration 45 days, are there any additional controls you need (insurance, IP/data clauses) for the pilot exception? Happy to include standard language if required.

Best,
Ella Park
Head of Partnerships | TrialCo
(Procurement contact: procurement@trialco.com)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ella Park <ella@trialco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 08 Mar 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO enforcement thresholds for TrialCo pilot

Great — thanks Ella, that timeline works. Confirming next steps and mutual action plan so we have a clear audit trail: 

Mutual action plan:
1) TrialCo: complete Vendor_Onboard_Form.xlsx and return it to hannah_schmitt@redwood.com by Mon Mar 9 COB (attachment stub).
2) TrialCo finance (procurement@trialco.com): confirm acceptance of a single consolidated invoice at pilot close and provide the billing contact for the invoice.
3) TrialCo / Marissa: sign SOW draft and upload to the shared Drive folder (link below) so legal can spot-check (no new terms expected).
4) Redwood procurement: Hannah will approve operational exception (45 days, $10k cap) once onboarding one-sheet and billing confirmation are received. Exception will be recorded in our intake tracker.
5) Finance / Billing: Redwood invoicing team will send a single invoice after Apr 12; if spend is below cap we will not require a PO.

Controls requested by Redwood for this exception: standard vendor onboarding one-sheet, insurance cert if available (not required for pilot), and a signed SOW or email confirmation of scope/dates. No special IP clauses required for a standard evaluation pilot — legal has flagged nothing urgent.

I've created a temporary intake ticket and attached the one-sheet (Vendor_Onboard_Form.xlsx). Once you return it I'll route for approval. If anything slips past the Mar 15 kickoff we will escalate to a 24-hour approval lane.

Shared Drive (SOW + onboarding): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cTrialCoOnboardChecklist
DocuSign (SOW link): https://app.docusign.com/transactions/ABC12345

Thanks — looking forward to the pilot.
